messages:
marco: Launch note 11: Were opening Dedicated B820 pools in South Asia (ap-bom) and Mexico City (latam-mex). These are targeted at customers needing high-memory multi-instance inference with strong FP16 perf and better cost-efficiency for large context use cases. Preview is gated; please read the opt-in doc: https://internal.redwood.ai/dedicated/b820-launch :loudspeaker:

deploy-bot: rollout started -> ap-bom-1, latam-mex-2. Canary run id rbw-roll-b820-2145678901. Initial health checks: ok.

gina: Quick policy Q: any new reservation limits or per-account caps for B820 during preview?

marco: Yes 11: preview caps are 8 GPUs/account by default. To request a higher allocation submit a capacity request to @sales-ops with justification (latency requirements, model sizes). Were enforcing caps to keep early capacity for test customers.

finance: Billing update: new SKU `dedicated.b820.hour` will be available for purchase on 2026-06-01. Preview customers will be billed under `DED-B820-PREVIEW` (discounted). Finance will publish mapping to existing invoice codes tomorrow.

sre-bot: SRE watches: token rate, GPU mem pressure, and page-fault counts. Suggested alerts:
- `sum(rate(gpu_memory_pressure[5m])) by (pool) > 0.7`
- `increase(page_faults_total[10m]) > 20`
- `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_bucket[5m])) by (le,pool)) > 700`

devops: Runtime note: B820 requires the `--enable-b820-ptx` flag in runtime to use optimized PTX kernels. Fallback kernels exist but perf will be ~15-25% worse. Add `RUNTIME_OPT_FLAGS=+b820_ptx` for full perf.

marco: Important: rotation policy change for Dedicated pools in these regions. To improve fairness during launches were enabling a soft-rotation window for every customer CPU-bound maintenance job. What that means:
- New requests will be routed to the active pool unless the pool load > 85%
- If load > 85% we will attempt to rotate-in burst capacity from a warm pool for 90s then fall back to queued reservations
- Customers on legacy reserved SKUs will not be rotated by default; they must opt-in with `rotation=true`

gina: Any console changes? I need to update the support KB.

marco: Console will show `pool_type: b820` and a new badge `preview` next to the pool name. There's a toggle to opt into rotation per pool. Also a new column in the reservation table `rotation_eligible` (true/false).

finance: Migration policy: existing Dedicated commitments can be migrated to B820 via a change order. Migration credits available: customers moving 6+ months of remaining commit get a 7% credit applied to the first invoice post-migration. SalesOps must approve.

tess: Any model guidance? We have a few perf notes to share with customers.

marco: Yes 11: B820 is optimized for large-context generative workloads (16k-64k). Best results with mixed precision (fp16 + int8 quant where supported). Avoid tiny batch sizes <2 for multi-instance scenarios; we see GPU utilization drop. We'll publish model perf matrix in the perf doc.

devops: CLI opt-in example:
```
# reserve example (preview)
redwood reserve --pool b820 --region ap-bom --gpus 4 --commit 3mo --rotation=true --contact infra-team@example.com --preview
```

marco: Known limitations: no autoscaling during preview, no preemptible instances, and HSM KMS rotation is manual for B820 for now. Were working to automate those.

sre-bot: Please add the following dashboards: `dedicated/b820/latency`, `dedicated/b820/mem-pressure`, `dedicated/b820/page-faults`. I'll create them and link in the playbook.

gina: I'll update support KB and prepare a canned response for customer inquiries. Also setting up an internal office hours for SRE/Support on Thu 16:00 UTC.

marco: Follow-ups: perf report and test workloads next Mon, migration playbook by Fri, and sales ops will run an invite-only outreach to top 25 spenders. Thanks all. :rocket:
